Companion Animal Travel Desk Intake and Care Rules

This section sets the standard for orderly handling of companion animal travel requests so that every traveler receives calm, consistent, and safe service. The desk will collect the needed travel details, confirm the animal's condition, and guide staff through the same careful steps on every file. <<FACT F008>> Each case will be reviewed for species needs, temperament, kennel fit, and comfort measures before acceptance is confirmed.

Staff will speak in clear, reassuring language and will keep the passenger informed of required documents, approved carriers, and any handling limits. Where an animal shows stress, the coordinator will slow the process, reduce noise, and seek support from the senior coordinator before continuing. <<FACT F019>> Any animal requiring special feeding, medication, or close supervision will be noted in the service record so that ground and cabin teams can prepare without delay.

Records must remain complete, accurate, and easy to follow, because consistent notes protect the passenger, the animal, and the operation. If a traveler arrives with concerns, the desk will respond with practical options and will avoid promises that cannot be supported by the booking and care review. Staff must also check that carrier conditions, labeling, and handover arrangements are suitable before the animal moves onward through Aurelia Skyways.

For any uncertainty, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
